components.evidence_level: Public source patch prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: The v0.1.8-alpha.1 hub release candidate pins the components released on 12 October 2026: gateway v0.1.0-alpha.7, Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.5, ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.10 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. The repeat-the-kit guide gains a label-based wiring diagram and troubleshooting, and points at these releases. The owner's OLED kit passed USB and Wi-Fi acceptance, and Grok Bot showed text through approved local shell execution; native Grok Bot MCP calls and independent reproduction are not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; Wi-Fi device listener used by one physical kit; Grok Bot local-command route observed
components.checks: 195 tests, Ruff, plain-language checks, package builds, twine check and the demo passed. Adds --version, private-home tests and the hand-started release workflow; its fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed. The LAN listener is unchanged from alpha.6, which the owner's ESP32-S3 OLED kit used for Wi-Fi acceptance. Native Grok Bot MCP calls and the tunnel route are not verified.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway v0.1.0-alpha.7; Ruff, package builds and twine check passed. Adds --version and the release workflow; the gateway extra pins v0.1.0-alpha.7. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (8/8), the contract check, the gateway PTY integration and three firmware builds passed. Alpha.10 shows Wi-Fi join failure reasons and fixes a provisioning stack overflow. On 12 October 2026 the owner saw Wrong password / Check password on the kit and provisioning worked with the fix (ESP32 SDK docs/verification/wifi-join-failure-2026-10-12.md). The USB and Wi-Fi acceptance of alpha.8 stands (docs/verification/oled-kit-wifi-2026-10-12.md). No network and Join timeout are host-tested only. One kit; not independently reproduced.

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.
